statement: Generated user-facing copy fails the audit only for objectively wrong statements: fabricated entities absent from the approved source, capability claims nothing evidences, a finished status with no receipt, a mutation the agent lacks authority to perform, or a reported failure whose clauses offer no next action. Style findings are always advisory and can never change the verdict, because a supplied voice sample may legitimately require them. When no source is supplied, fabrication is reported as unchecked rather than passed.
